doc.name: Echoteka - audio mastering
doc.instructions: Audio mastering tools. Analysis, AI artifact cleanup, preset previews and job status are free. 1 full master per day (UTC) is free without an account; extra masters use credits, which a human buys on the website - an agent cannot pay. Full rules: resource echoteka://playbook.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.title: Service info
tools.description: What Echoteka does, what is free, what a credit buys, and where the rules live. Call once at the start of a session.

outputSchema.description: Service manifest: endpoints, presets, live prices, limits, policies.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.title: List mastering presets
tools.description: All mastering presets with their target loudness in LUFS. Call this to get the exact preset keys that master_track and batch_master accept. Use preview_styles instead when you want to HEAR 2-6 of them on the actual track before choosing, and get_service_info when you need the wider service manifest rather than the preset list. Free.

tools.name: check_limits
tools.title: Check quota and balance
tools.description: What this caller may do right now: free master left today and when it resets, credit balance, upload cap, whether advanced modules are available. Call before mastering.

max_upload_mb_via_mcp.description: effective per-file ceiling for THIS channel

tools.name: analyze_track
tools.title: Analyze a track
tools.description: Measure integrated LUFS, sample peak, duration, sample rate and stereo correlation without processing. Free, a couple of seconds. Run this before choosing a preset. Note: true peak and loudness range are NOT part of this fast pass — they are measured on the result and come back from get_job.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file (wav/mp3/flac/m4a). A share link to the page works too — Suno/Udio song pages, Google Drive and Dropbox links are resolved to the file automatically.

true_peak_db.description: null in the fast pass; see get_job for the measured value

tools.name: clean_ai_trace
tools.title: Clean AI generator artifacts
tools.description: Remove the marks an AI generator leaves in the audio (narrow tones above 15 kHz, level jumps at block seams, fixed spectral peaks); loudness and tone stay as they are. It does not hide that a track is AI-made - disclose AI use wherever a platform asks. Free, never spends a credit. Returns a job id - poll get_job.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file (wav/mp3/flac/m4a). A share link to the page works too — Suno/Udio song pages, Google Drive and Dropbox links are resolved to the file automatically.

tools.name: preview_styles
tools.title: Compare presets on 24 seconds
tools.description: Master the middle 24 s of the track in 2-6 presets at once and get each one's loudness plus a listen link. FREE (6 per day). Use this instead of guessing a preset, and instead of spending a credit to 'try' one.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file (wav/mp3/flac/m4a). A share link to the page works too — Suno/Udio song pages, Google Drive and Dropbox links are resolved to the file automatically.

styles.description: Preset keys from list_presets. Default: edm, pop, rnb, standard.

tools.name: master_track
tools.title: Master a track
tools.description: Master one track. Uses 1 CREDIT when the account has a balance; otherwise it runs on the free quota (1 free master per day (UTC), without advanced modules). Returns a job id immediately - poll get_job (typical 20-60 s, up to 10 min with restoration). The source is fetched by this server, so the ceiling here is 100 MB per file. Pass dry_run=true first if you want to see what would be used and the effective settings before anything is spent.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file (wav/mp3/flac/m4a). A share link to the page works too — Suno/Udio song pages, Google Drive and Dropbox links are resolved to the file automatically.

style.description: Preset key from list_presets, e.g. edm, hiphop, podcast, unlimiter. Default standard.

target_lufs.description: Override the preset target, e.g. -14 for Spotify.

remove_watermark.description: Also run AI artifact cleanup first. Free.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL to POST the result to instead of polling.

restore_dynamics.description: Open up a brickwalled source before mastering (pairs with style unlimiter).

intensity.description: Multiplier on the preset's multiband compression: 1.0 as designed, 0.5 gentler, 1.5 denser. Values outside 0.5-1.5 are clamped.

dither_type.description: Dither for 16-bit WAV output: tpdf (default), ns_e or ns_itu (noise-shaped).

dry_run.description: Do not master: report what this call would use and what settings would apply. Nothing is charged, the file is not even downloaded.

tools.name: batch_master
tools.title: Master an album or a batch
tools.description: Master up to 10 tracks in one call with the same settings. Needs N CREDITS for N tracks, or N free runs - not one. album_mode (default true) levels the tracks RELATIVE to each other: the loudest hits the target exactly, the others keep their offsets, so a quiet interlude is not inflated to single level. Limits: 10 tracks, 100 MB per file and 300 MB per call (this server's own caps, for memory). A big album takes minutes - send fewer, longer tracks per call rather than all at once. Returns one job id per track - poll each with get_job. Pass dry_run=true to see what would be used and the settings before anything is spent.

audio_urls.description: Public https URLs, in album order.

target_lufs.description: Target for the LOUDEST track in album mode.

remove_watermark.description: Also run AI artifact cleanup first. Free.

album_mode.description: Keep relative loudness between tracks. Default true. Set false for unrelated singles.

dry_run.description: Report what would be used and the settings without mastering and without downloading anything.

tracks.description: job_id, filename, source_url, target_lufs and album_lufs_offset as APPLIED by the server

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get job status
tools.description: Status, progress and result metrics (after_lufs, true_peak_db, lra, platform_ready) for a mastering, cleanup or preview job. For previews it returns each style with its loudness and a listen link. When a master is done it also returns download_url - a signed link that works without credentials for about an hour. Free.

job_id.description: Job id returned by master_track, clean_ai_trace or preview_styles; batch_master returns one per track in job_ids. Not a URL or a filename: 1-64 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -

prompts.name: master_for_platform
prompts.title: Master for a streaming platform
prompts.description: Analyze the track, pick the preset and the platform target, master it, and report LUFS / true peak back.

arguments.name: audio_url
arguments.description: Public https URL of the track, or a share link to its page.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.description: Destination: spotify, youtube, apple, podcast, audiobook, club.

prompts.name: fix_ai_track
prompts.title: Clean and master a Suno track
prompts.description: Clean the AI generator artifacts first, then master with the unlimiter preset if the source is brickwalled.

arguments.name: audio_url
arguments.description: Public https URL of the track, or a share link to its page.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.description: Destination for the final master, e.g. spotify.

resources.name: Mastering passport
resources.description: Interactive result card: loudness before/after, true peak, range, target deviation and the download link.

resources.name: Agent playbook
resources.description: Rules for agents using the service.
